in_text_mentions: e neck was done, which showed the diagnosis of lymphatic malformation with hemorrhage within. The ultrasound of the neck showed a well-defined, oval-shaped, multiloculated but interconnected cystic lesion of size 2.1 x 1.6 x 2.6 cm seen in the soft tissues of the posterior triangle of the neck on the left side, showing multiple fluid-debris levels, with indentation over the left external jugular vein suggestive of lymphatic malformation with hemorrhage within.
